purpose: Bind published Fig. 8(d) to an original cycling file or rule out machine-readable source data in the versioned deposit.
content_order: Inventory all three folder listings; download only pertinent Fig. 8(d) asset and any tabular content explicitly linked to its cycling test. If graphical only, compare with P48 original, record axis, marker counts and original vs digitized evidence. Do not treat Fig. S5 or Fig. 6 rate current as actual Fig. 8(d) cycling current.
paper_check: Use the already seen accepted manuscript and version of record when available; require sample, actual 2E, electrolyte, horizon, reported cycling current, own normalization and at least three positive observations within the approved early window. Keep missing and conflicting values as separate evidence.
disposition: Known endpoint, development only. Keep two electrolytes in a single article group. No new fitting, blind-lock claim or canonical admission. If original data are unavailable, retain the specific hold condition and count only existing evidence.
